profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at Molokai Condo Rentals
profile.summary:
www.austinpjames.com 

I am a Full-Stack Developer with a passion for building responsive cross-platform applications focused on the user.

As a lifelong learner with many interests, I have led a diverse professional career. Every position has provided me with a unique perspective toward critical problem-solving and team-building. Nothing, however, has satisfied my desire to learn and grow more than the supportive tech community of Web Development. My love for modern technology has inspired me to enrich the lives of others through creative, analytical methodologies. 

Skills: HTML5 | CSS3 | JavaScript | ReactJS | Redux | NodeJS | Express | Python | SQL | Wordpress

positions.description:

• Created a detailed technical slideshow for client to guide through CMS and booking flow
